title: rosa reuteri f. typica
intro: Rosa reuteri f. typica, commonly known as the "Peruvian Rose" or "Rosa de la Reina", is a medicinal plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It has been traditionally used in Peruvian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Rosa reuteri f. typica include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing.
